question: According to the plot, around how many more times will Subaru die? In the actual writing, how many more times do you think Subaru will die?
answer: The number of deaths can increase as I go with the flow, so the number of times he dies isn’t determined by the plot. I don’t want to do digest-like deaths (note: I think he may mean something like a death montage here), so even if there’s a lot, there probably won’t be fifty more times. (May 26, 2014 arc4)
